replies.author: btriapitsyn
replies.excerpt: Fixed in 7d037b07d. The thinking level now stays with the model it was set for. Switching models drops it, and the new model starts on its own level: whatever you picked for it earlier in the session…

en.headline: 9 own commits plus 19 automated; commented on a bug and started a discussion
en.summary: Across 3 repositories, **9 own commits** were made: in `opencode-skill-management`, 5 commits revised the `skill_management` spec (removing stale doc references, relocating plans to `.openchamber/plans`, adding Steps checklists, unifying line endings to LF, and publishing a revised spec with feasibility evaluation); in `sogeisetsu`, 3 commits fixed the verify invariant scanner, added notifier graceful degradation, and shipped AI failure visibility with model annotation and a 30-day summary redesign — **19 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` were also recorded; in `opencode-agent-sandbox`, 1 commit documented a new `opencode-provider` knowledge category covering catalog sources, credential ownership, and endpoint jurisdiction. The user commented on `openchamber/openchamber` `#4939` (2 comments), started discussion `#5114` titled "Split the rendered-page selection-menu fix: frame→host selection bridge first (#4939)", and received replies on `#4601` and `#4899`. Three state changes were observed: `#4896`, `#4920`, and `#4601` were closed by `btriapitsyn`.

zh.headline: 9 次本人提交另有 19 次自动提交；评论了 bug 并发起讨论
zh.summary: 在 3 个仓库中共有 **9 次本人提交**：在 `opencode-skill-management` 中，5 次提交修订了 `skill_management` 规范（删除失效文档引用、将计划迁移至 `.openchamber/plans`、补充 Steps 清单、统一换行符为 LF、发布修订版规范并附可行性评测）；在 `sogeisetsu` 中，3 次提交修复了验证不变式扫描器、增加 notifier 优雅降级、新增 AI 失败可见性与模型标注及 30 天总结改版——**另有 19 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**；在 `opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，1 次提交记录了新增的 `opencode-provider` 知识类别（涵盖 catalog 来源、凭据归属与端点管辖）。用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 `#4939` 下评论（共 2 条评论），发起了讨论 `#5114`（标题为 "Split the rendered-page selection-menu fix: frame→host selection bridge first (#4939)"），并收到了 `#4601` 和 `#4899` 的回复。观察到 3 项状态变更：`#4896`、`#4920` 和 `#4601` 由 `btriapitsyn` 关闭。
